description:
Spatial convergence of the UNLIMITED (centred) fourth-order CW84 flux-form vertical advection operator grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_flux_D_lev_noflux_bc, driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_vertical_ppm_flux. 

FORCED-STEADY (TRUNCATION) IDIOM, identical to its siblings: u*(z) = cos(pi z) is an exact steady state of the forced equation, so the drift at t = 0.1 IS the truncation error and the observed rate is the truncation order. Measured medians: L2 3.99 (pairwise 3.96, 3.99, 4.00) and Linf 3.94 (pairwise 3.86, 3.94, 3.97) -- a clean fourth order, which is the formal order of the CW84 eq (1.6) interpolant, so expected_order 4.0 asserts what was measured AND what the theory predicts. 

THIS CASE IS THE ACCURACY CEILING OF THE ppm_flux FAMILY. The gap between the 3.99/3.94 measured here and the 2.49/1.98 measured by the monotone sibling latlon3d_advection_vertical_ppm_flux_mono on the IDENTICAL manufactured solution is the quantified cost of boundedness -- and the gap in the other direction, against the 0.96 of the first-order donor-cell case latlon3d_advection_vertical_upwind_flux, is the accuracy win of reconstructing at all. At NLEV = 64 the three schemes sit at L2 = 1.39e-2 (donor), 1.61e-4 (monotone, 86x better) and 1.82e-7 (this one, 76000x better). The three drivers share one MMS by construction so that these numbers are directly comparable.

THE LADDER IS 16/32/64/128, AND BOTH ENDS ARE CHOSEN, NOT INHERITED. The donor-cell sibling case latlon3d_advection_vertical_upwind_flux runs 32/64/128/256 because a FIRST-order scheme is still pre-asymptotic at 16 (its Linf pairwise orders there run 0.34, 0.78, 0.91). A high-order scheme has the opposite problem at BOTH ends. At the coarse end it is already asymptotic at 16 -- the pairwise orders below are flat to two decimals across every rung, which is the actual test of asymptoticity and is what licenses starting there. At the FINE end it runs out of room: by NLEV = 256 the unlimited sibling's spatial error is down to ~7e-10, which is the same size as the Tsit5 temporal/roundoff floor at reltol 1e-11, and the measured Linf rate on that last pair collapses to 3.49 purely as a solver artefact. Including such a rung would be measuring the ODE solver, not the operator. The governing principle is the same one that moved the donor-cell ladder OUT to 256 -- measure inside the asymptotic window -- and here that window is 16..128. Neither end was chosen by loosening order_tolerance to make a bad ladder pass.
